currentDeviceTestScope: phone-only; tablet design and later release qualification retained

scenarios.name: Simple drink, immediate cash
assertions: No unnecessary modifier modal
One durable paid sale; one portion consumed

scenarios.name: Modified drink
assertions: Extra counted once
Variant, extra and note survive editing and receipt history

scenarios.name: Single meal portion
assertions: One named pizza flavor portion consumed
Verbal preparation/handoff needs no kitchen screen

scenarios.name: Mixed drink and meal
assertions: Both lines saved atomically
Two correct tracked portions consumed

scenarios.name: Takeout note
assertions: Takeout and note persist online/offline without mandatory customer details

scenarios.name: Delivery note
assertions: Delivery type preserved
No invented dispatch service or customer PII required

scenarios.name: Sold-out portion
assertions: Fixture stock is zero
Search/card/selection prevent sale; no money collected or stock movement

scenarios.name: Save unpaid then pay later
assertions: Save Unpaid reserves once without recognizing revenue
Later payment consumes reservation, not another portion
Only one payment and sale identity

scenarios.name: Manual GCash
assertions: Cashier explicitly confirms owner-approved manual check
Not labelled gateway verified
No cash drawer increase or cash tender

scenarios.name: Unprepared unpaid cancellation
assertions: Cashier guarded cancellation records reason and unprepared disposition
One reservation released including repeated request
No general cashier inventory UPDATE grant

scenarios.name: Prepared or unknown cancellation
assertions: Prepared/unknown portion not restored to sellable stock
Waste/disposition recorded; payment not invented

scenarios.name: Owner cash refund
assertions: Owner-only linked refund 3900 centavos with reason
Original paid sale retained; cashier attempt denied
Prepared food not automatically restocked
Refund reduces drawer once

scenarios.name: Offline cash and force-stop restart
assertions: Previously enrolled/authorized device cold-starts offline
Sale/payment/outbox durable before success
Force-stop preserves paid pending-sync record and actor
Reconnect yields exactly one sale/payment and two portion effects

scenarios.name: Ambiguous response and fifth failure
assertions: Server commit then lost response replays same identity once
Enqueue during sync loses no record
Five failed attempts retain payment/history in needs attention
Offline alone does not consume attempts

scenarios.name: Same-device cashier handover
assertions: Separate outgoing/incoming staff accounts and counted cash
Unsynced sale remains attributed to outgoing actor
GCash reconciles separately
Offline hardware transfer blocked; records never erased

scenarios.name: Three-pizza mixed bundle
assertions: Exactly three choices; repeated flavor allowed with stock
Hawaiian consumes two portions; Pepperoni one
Parent charged 9900, not three standalone prices or parent plus children
Same-flavor alternative consumes three of that flavor

scenarios.name: Two bundles and replay
assertions: Four Hawaiian and two Pepperoni portions consumed exactly once
Restart/replay preserves bundle composition and fixed price

scenarios.name: Bundle shortage or invalid composition
assertions: Only one Hawaiian portion available, two requested: reject new sale
Server also rejects fewer/more than three or unauthorized flavors
No silent substitution, partial stock effect or payment

scenarios.name: Whole-bundle owner refund
assertions: Linked refund amount 9900; duplicate/excess refund denied
No per-pizza partial bundle refund in initial scope
Prepared portions not automatically restored

scenarios.name: Storage error and duplicate-tap protection
assertions: No saved-success message or cleared cart on failed local write
Disable repeated final action while saving
Show actionable recovery; do not collect again if cash already received
